snippet.title: Saborus | Launch Trailer - Horror game for Steam (PC), Xbox, PlayStation and Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
Ever wondered what horror feels like when you’re the one on the menu?

The game Saborus turns the tables (and the knives) putting you in the fragile body of a terrified chicken inside a grim slaughterhouse. No guns. No superpowers. Just instinct, fear, and the desperate urge to survive.

Inspired by a true story and the tragic death of the developer’s pet chicken, Saborus blends the eerie atmosphere of Resident Evil with the tragic absurdity of Oddworld: Abe’s Oddysee. The result? A darkly poetic experience that’s equal parts survival horror, empathy test, and wake-up call.

Run, hide and survive before someone decides you look delicious.

Saborus is AVAILABLE NOW on Steam, PS5, PS4, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch.

📅 Release date: November 20, 2025
✅ Available Now: https://www.qubytegames.store/allgames/saborus
